title: 走进AI Agent第三篇：让 Agent 记住你
content: This article explains how to implement persistent user memory in AI Agents, enabling cross-session personalization. It introduces a three-tier evaluation framework (basic recall, multi-session retrieval, proactive service) and categorizes memory by hierarchy, storage formats (e.g., Simple Notes to Advanced JSON Cards), and cognitive types. The text contrasts transient context with durable memory, detailing engineering frameworks like Mem0 and MemGPT for extraction and conflict resolution. Advanced representations, including executable code and parametric edits, are discussed for better reasoning. Finally, it addresses memory compression, privacy protection via local PII sanitization, and data governance, emphasizing the trade-off between simplicity and expressiveness in memory system design.

title: 三年了，AI为何还没有抢走程序员饭碗？
content: Despite significant productivity gains, software developer employment has remained stable, contradicting predictions of mass displacement. This occurs because AI lowers development costs, stimulating new demand and enabling more product iterations rather than reducing headcount. Furthermore, labor market data indicates that entry-level roles are declining as AI automates routine tasks, thereby increasing the relative value of experienced programmers. Thus, AI primarily shifts the workforce toward senior roles by expanding the scope of viable software projects.

title: Nature 论文：司美格鲁肽使老年雌鼠延寿约 12%
content: A Nature study by UC Berkeley’s Danica Chen team reports that semaglutide extended the median lifespan of elderly female mice by approximately 12.4% and improved cognitive and motor functions. The treatment reduced food intake by 24%, inducing molecular changes similar to but superior in some aspects to caloric restriction. While this GLP-1 receptor agonist shows potential longevity benefits, the findings are limited to a single mouse strain. The study lacks evidence for male mice or humans and faces methodological critiques, including short control lifespans. It nevertheless advances research into GLP-1 mechanisms in aging.
